name: Beta-geometric correction (experimental)
description: Fits TRANSIT-style beta-geometric parameters including catalogue zeros, maps counts to a group geometric target and optionally applies explicit post-TTR scaling.
may_suit: Sensitivity analysis for heavy-tailed insertion support dominated by a few sites when a geometric target is scientifically defensible.
caution: May suppress genuine enrichment; catalogue zeros affect fitted parameters; not a viable-mutant abundance model. Analytic CDF default; seeded simulation available. No automatic preference.
